test_system.scope: Whole main with complete 250ms-equivalent ADC words and raw packet; ADC cadence, TX numeric payload, FP parameter latency and UART bit timing modeled. Does not claim full 250ms physical-cadence simulation. Raw frame RAM uses the same-latency behavioral model; its Intel primitive interface is checked separately by the short pin test. FFT memory uses Intel altsyncram.

io.buffer_model: behavioral, same read latency; short pin test checks Intel raw RAM

tx_parameters.scope: Parameter pipeline and startup only; full-duration waveform not repeated
